name: Lenka Svobodová
bio:
Lenka's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A gifted engineering student, she initially envisioned a career in aerospace. However, a chance encounter with a local racing team during a university project ignited a passion she couldn't ignore. The raw power and intricate mechanics of racing engines captivated her, leading her to redirect her skills and knowledge to the world of competitive motorsport. Her meticulous nature and problem-solving skills quickly made her an indispensable part of any team she joined.

Lenka approaches her role with a relentless pursuit of precision and efficiency. She believes that even the smallest adjustments can make a significant difference on the track. Known for her innovative solutions and unwavering dedication, Lenka is a valuable asset to V8 Masters Racing. Her ability to diagnose and resolve mechanical issues under pressure, combined with her keen eye for detail, sets her apart as a machinist who is not only technically skilled but also deeply invested in the team's overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back into a practical ponytail
physical.description: Lenka has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always has a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and ideas.
Insists on using a specific set of vintage tools she inherited from her grandfather.
Communicates best through technical jargon and hand gestures.
